summary: Tested Instant Note Alerts, Note Read Receipt and Saved Delivery Notes. Backend: 8/8 new pytest cases passed, and the 17 iteration-20 customer-note regression tests passed too. They cover saved-notes CRUD, 401/403 access, phone normalization, 400 checks, replacing a note on upsert, 404 on delete, import prefill ('saved', 'last', saved note wins, clearing removes the last note), and the read receipt (it gets set by /seen, appears in public track, needs a driver, and resets when the customer saves a new note). Frontend (390x844): the driver banner appeared 0.19s after the customer saved, so it came from the websocket and not the 8s poll. The customer saw 'SENT · NOT READ YET', then 'DRIVER HAS READ YOUR NOTE' within 0.1-0.3s of GOT IT or OPEN DROP, with no reload. After a re-save the receipt went back to unread. In the merchant saved-notes card, add, invalid-phone error, list and delete all worked. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the reviewed files.

issues: A note prefilled from the store's saved note or the customer's last note shows 'SENT · NOT READ YET' even though the customer never sent it. There is no 'from your last order' or 'saved by the store' label. customer_note_source is not included in order_private (server.py:516), so the UI can't tell.

action_items: Optional UX: include customer_note_source in order_private and show a label in CustomerNote such as 'Filled in from your last order' or 'Saved by the store'.
Optional: prefilled notes keep customer_note_seen=True by default, so the driver gets no GOT IT banner for them. They are marked read only when the driver opens the stop. This is fine if intended.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerNote.tsx: useState(note) does not resync if the note prop changes after mount (for example when another device edits it). Minor.
Saved notes are only applied in process_row (CSV import). Stops created any other way never get them. Fine for the current scope.
seed_data_creation: None kept. The tests use phone +14155550177 and TEST_ stops, and clean them up afterwards. login_attempts were cleared and admin reset was called.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n0. The import background job uses the cached geocode for '1 Market St'. Poll import_rows. Get the driver token from /auth/driver-login (+14155550101 / 482913). /customer-note/seen requires a driver or admin. Afterwards clear login_attempts drv|trk and call admin reset.
